$$\frac{4x^3-6x^2-18x+20}{x^2-4} \equiv ax+b+\frac{c}{x-2} \qquad x \neq \pm 2$$
find the values of the constants $a$, $b$ and $c$.
(4)

Way 1: M1: Divides $4x^3-6x^2-18x+20$ by $x^2-4$ to get a linear quotient and a linear remainder (look for minimum working of the division). A1: Quotient $=4x-6$ and Remainder $=-2x-4$.
